Credentials are provided only inside the simulated service. Do not put literal credentials into files. Reload then eval_probe target="stream" input="ping" sends a simulated request. Events contain {"delta":{"text":"po"}}, {"delta":{"text":"ng"}}, then event complete. Configure text_field="delta.text" and done_event="complete".
